lanes.title: Terminology normalization
lanes.focus: Normalize Estonian technical vocabulary, model/version names, acronyms. Preserve meaning.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify at most one term whose usage is inconsistent or non-idiomatic in Estonian technical writing within the target file.
lanes.writer_extra: Apply a surgical rename or rewording in the target file only. If no clear win, push back and commit nothing.

lanes.title: Chapter readiness polish
lanes.focus: Flow, signposting, paragraph coherence inside one chapter.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify the single weakest transition or paragraph in the target chapter.
lanes.writer_extra: Rewrite at most that paragraph or transition. No new claims. No new references.

lanes.title: Committee-facing explanation
lanes.focus: Anticipate a likely defense committee question and tighten the passage that already tries to answer it.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Pose one committee-style question and point to the passage meant to pre-empt it.
lanes.writer_extra: Tighten that passage so a skeptical committee member cannot easily push on it. Do not introduce new claims.

lanes.title: Claim–evidence alignment
lanes.focus: Each claim must be backed by a concrete number, table, figure, or cited source.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Find one claim whose evidence is vague or missing in the target file.
lanes.writer_extra: Either attach the existing evidence in-text, or soften the claim to what is defensible. No fabricated numbers.

lanes.title: Literature gap framing
lanes.focus: How the Kratt work positions against existing Estonian NLP / wake-word literature.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one place where the literature gap or positioning is weak or missing.
lanes.writer_extra: Strengthen that positioning using sources already in references.bib. Do not invent citations.

lanes.title: Formal LaTeX compliance
lanes.focus: TalTech/Estonian thesis formal style: quotes, dashes, units, cross-references, figure/table captions.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one concrete formal-style issue in the target file (e.g., straight quotes, missing non-breaking space, broken \ref).
lanes.writer_extra: Fix only that one issue. No stylistic rewriting.

lanes.title: Summary tightening
lanes.focus: Keep summary crisp, self-contained, aligned with actual contributions.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Find the single sentence in the summary that overclaims, underclaims, or drifts from the thesis contributions.

lanes.title: Methodology tightening
lanes.focus: Reproducibility of wake-word methodology: data, augmentation, training, evaluation.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one methodology detail that a reader could not reproduce from the current text.
lanes.writer_extra: Add the missing detail concisely in-place. Do not expand scope.

lanes.title: Introduction builder
lanes.focus: Build the thin introduction into a complete thesis opening: problem, scope, research questions, contribution, and limits.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify the single highest-value missing introduction sentence or short paragraph that would clarify the thesis scope or contribution.
lanes.writer_extra: Add or rewrite at most one short paragraph in the introduction. Use only claims already supported by repo evidence or existing citations. No broad reframing.

lanes.title: Implementation narrative
lanes.focus: Turn repo implementation evidence into thesis prose: Android logger, ESP32-S3/Korvo-2, ESPHome voice_assistant, demo pipeline, packaging, and configuration choices.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one missing implementation detail that is already evidenced in the repo and belongs in the current discussion/implementation prose.
lanes.writer_extra: Add at most one evidence-backed implementation paragraph. Prefer concrete file-backed facts over architecture wishes. Do not claim unvalidated deployment status.

lanes.title: Evaluation closeout
lanes.focus: Close evaluation gaps in small pieces: v16c, expert-a, MoE consensus, field evidence, user-test framing, and limits.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one missing evaluation result, limitation, or bridge that is already supported by tracked artifacts or current thesis TODO/source-of-truth docs.
lanes.writer_extra: Add or tighten at most one short result/limitation paragraph. Keep benchmark, field, and planned user-test evidence clearly separated.

lanes.title: Alternatives and comparison
lanes.focus: Incrementally build the background comparison against existing wake-word and voice-assistant alternatives.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify one missing comparison point against an already cited or repo-documented alternative such as microWakeWord, openWakeWord, Picovoice, commercial assistants, or Estonian ASR.
lanes.writer_extra: Add at most one comparison sentence or paragraph using existing references.bib entries or repo-documented evidence only. If new external research is needed, push back instead of inventing citations.

lanes.title: Research note
lanes.focus: Draft one small, evidence-backed research note that will be distilled into thesis prose next.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify the single most useful unresolved comparative/evidence gap for the next thesis sentence.
lanes.writer_extra: Append exactly one concise research note item with source file references and what sentence it should inform.

lanes.title: Distill sentence
lanes.focus: Turn the newest research note into exactly one thesis sentence/mini-paragraph, without adding unsupported claims.
lanes.reviewer_extra: Identify the target sentence location that directly maps to the latest research note and can be added in one edit.
lanes.writer_extra: Add or refine one sentence/mini-paragraph based on the latest research-note queue item. No extra restructuring.
